result:
Summary: The Dragon1 Framework for Enterprise Architecture can be used without further training attention architecture as it includes a coherent set of constructive, operative, and decorative concepts that can predict higher quality structures when starting at the conceptual level for the design. The BDH architecture, which shares attention-inspired computation with the Transformer, can also host without further training, utilizing linear attention over low-rank representation of values and employing parameter-free LayerNorm. The BDH-GPU is a tensor-friendly, GPU-efficient implementation of the BDH architecture, which updates neuron states and attention-like values through a recurrent update process.
